The '''Eye Patch''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be purchased from the [[Abandoned House]] for {{Price|5000}} after earning the "Master Angler" [[Achievements|Achievement]] (catch every [[fish]]).

==Secret==
{{collapse|content= 
While wearing it, speaking to the bartender in the [[Ginger Island#Pirate Cove|Pirate Cove]] causes him to give the player [[mead]]. This can only be done once per night.}}

==History==
{{History|1.0|Introduced.}}
{{History|1.6|Purchase price increased from {{Price|1000}} to {{Price|5000}}.}}
